thread:
sara: Quick idea  what if we create a tiny 'adapter' layer per cloud that maps our canonical refkit module inputs to provider-specific packaging and metadata? Keeps module dev simple and centralizes marketplace quirks. Thoughts?

mike: love it. adapters could be thin terraform wrappers + a small metadata YAML that the publish pipeline consumes. That way modules stay pure TF and we have deterministic artifact outputs.

jon: +1. Also suggest an examples/quickstart that uses the adapter so partners see the exact deploy path for marketplace offers. Important for partner onboarding calls.

nina: From partnerships: must include a checklist for listing requirements (legal, logos, support SLAs). Also a short README for SIs about customizing the refkit for customer environments.

mike: CI suggestion: when a module changes, run a job that validates adapters for all providers but only publishes adapters for providers listed in the PR label (e.g., "publish:aws"). Prevent accidental cross-publishing.

jon: we'll need tiny tests: plan-only validation, small terratest that does plan+apply with tiny instance types or local mocks. Keep costs low.

publibot: Note: marketplace metadata schema updated (azure-v2). See https://internal.docs/marketplace/metadata-v2

sara: good call. let's make adapter contract explicit: mapping table for inputs that differ (e.g., instance_type -> sku_id) and transform hooks for metadata (license, support url).

nina: also add a 'partner-ready' badge in README when module + adapter pass the matrix (makes it easy for GTM).

mike: I can prototype adapter layout: adapters/aws/, adapters/azure/, adapters/gcp/, each with publish.yml + metadata.yaml + small wrapper.tf. Will include a generator script to create metadata from module outputs.

jon: timeline idea: prototype adapter for one module + AWS adapter by next Tue. If that looks good we scale to other modules/providers.

sara: assign owners: mike -> adapter prototype, jon -> test harness + examples, nina -> partner checklist and GTM badge criteria. We'll review in 2 days.

nina: tagging partner-eng and solutions-eng when prototype PRs land. :rocket:

mike: starting a repo skeleton branch now. PR will reference adapter RFC.

publibot: CI job created: adapters/prototype/ci -> queued.

sara: Thanks team. This should reduce friction for cloud marketplace onboarding and make our refkits more maintainable.

jon: will add smoke test doc to examples/README.

mike: PR up later today.
